appearance.create.summary: Create a design-local appearance by copying a library or design appearance (with a new name) or, when the installed SDK supports it, a neutral appearance. Returns the actual copy ID, never an assumed ID.
limitations: Appearances.add is a preview feature; prefer copying an existing appearance by id. The copy is design-local and its actual ID is returned; a copied ID is never assumed unique. Appearance is visual only and independent from physical material.

inputs.name: Required nonempty new name; must be unique within the design appearances.
inputs.id: Optional exact appearance ID to copy (from appearance.list).
inputs.library: Optional loaded library ID containing the appearance; omit for design-local.
inputs.surfaceType: Optional opaque/metal/transparent for a neutral add; ignored when copying by id.

appearance.edit.summary: Edit a design-local appearance: rename it and set typed properties through appearanceProperties. Returns before/after typed properties.
limitations: Targets design-local appearances only; copy a library resource first with appearance.create. Typed properties are set via the concrete Property subclasses; read-only properties are rejected. Editing a property value removes any connected texture on a FloatProperty.

inputs.id: Required exact design-local appearance ID from appearance.list.
inputs.name: Optional new unique name.
inputs.properties: Optional nonempty array of {id, value}; value type must match the property (float/int/bool/string/choice/color).

appearance.texture.summary: Connect or disconnect a texture image on an appearance channel (color/normal/roughness) and set real-world scale, bump type and rotation.
limitations: colorTexture/normalTexture/roughnessTexture are preview features; the image is embedded in the document but the returned path may differ after save/reopen. Real-world scale and bump use appearanceProperties only when a writable property exists; otherwise those sub-fields are reported blocked, never silently ignored.

inputs.image: Optional path to the texture image; empty string disconnects it.
inputs.scaleX: Optional real-world scale X length expression.
inputs.scaleY: Optional real-world scale Y length expression.
inputs.bump: Optional boolean; true selects height-map bump on the normal channel.
inputs.lock: Optional boolean; true makes scaleX/scaleY follow each other when only one is given.

appearance.projection.summary: Read or set the texture projection type (automatic/planar/box/spherical/cylindrical) of a design-local appearance.
limitations: Projection is a texture property, not a geometric projection frame. If the installed SDK exposes no writable texture_ProjectionType property, a set request is blocked.

inputs.projection: automatic, planar, box, spherical, or cylindrical; omitted reads current.

appearance.assign-map.summary: Read the visual appearance assignment map across selected entities and optionally compare it against an expected physical appearance, returning mismatches.
limitations: Read-only. A face reads its body appearance and an occurrence reads its component definition. Equal IDs do not establish inheritance provenance. A duplicate name/ID is a mismatch candidate, never assumed equivalent.

inputs.refs: Optional nonempty Component/BRepBody/BRepFace/Occurrence refs; omit to map all bodies/components/faces/occurrences.
inputs.expected: Optional map of {ref name -> expected appearance id}; mismatches are reported.
inputs.library: Optional library ID; not used for the read, kept for workflow symmetry.

material.create.summary: Create a design-local physical material by copying a library or design material with a new name. Returns the actual copy ID.
limitations: Physical materials can only be copied (Materials.addByCopy); there is no neutral add. The copy is design-local and the actual ID is returned. No density/mass validation is performed.

inputs.name: Required nonempty new name; must be unique within the design materials.
inputs.id: Required exact material ID to copy (from material.list).
inputs.library: Optional loaded library ID containing the material.

material.edit.summary: Edit a design-local physical material: rename, set description and set typed physical properties through materialProperties.
limitations: Targets design-local materials only; copy a library resource first with material.create. A missing density is reported, never replaced by a default. Physical material is separate from visual appearance.

inputs.name: Optional new unique name.
inputs.properties: Optional nonempty array of {id, value}; value type must match the property.

material.assign-map.summary: Read the physical material assignment map across selected entities and optionally compare it against expected materials, returning mismatches.
limitations: Read-only. A face reads its body material and an occurrence reads its component definition. Equal IDs do not establish inheritance. No mass or density validation is performed.

inputs.refs: Optional nonempty Component/BRepBody/BRepFace/Occurrence refs; omit to map all.
inputs.expected: Optional map of {ref name -> expected material id}; mismatches are reported.
inputs.library: Optional library ID; not used for the read.

styles.report.summary: Aggregate appearance and material states across definitions/instances/faces with duplicate name/ID and missing-density detection.
limitations: Read-only. A duplicate name/ID is reported, not assumed equivalent. A missing material density is reported, never replaced. Appearance and physical material are reported separately.

inputs.refs: Optional nonempty refs to scope the report; omit to map all bodies/components/faces/occurrences.
